title: Principles for software
description: Define behavior explicitly, validate it with independent checks and realistic
  execution conditions, and limit claims to accessible evidence.
kind: principles
---

# Principles for software

1. Define the output contract, including counting units and whitespace semantics, and obtain an explicit decision before implementing conflicting requirements — evidence: [字符计数先区分码点、可见字符和空白](pages/lessons/20261021-unicode-counting-contract.md), [输出契约冲突时先取得明确裁定](pages/lessons/20261020-conflicting-output-contracts.md).
2. Check boundary behavior against independently expressed reference algorithms using bounded exhaustive inputs and adversarial cases rather than duplicating implementation logic or asserting only output length — evidence: [字符计数先区分码点、可见字符和空白](pages/lessons/20261021-unicode-counting-contract.md), [用完整单词参考算法检查截断边界](pages/lessons/20261020-truncate-independent-oracle.md), [用保持打开的标准输入检查 CLI 是否提前阻塞](pages/lessons/20261020-cli-stdin-validation.md).
3. Verify public CLI behavior in real subprocesses with explicit import environments and open as well as closed input pipes to expose failures hidden by library tests or convenient fixtures — evidence: [pytest 能导入源码不代表 CLI 子进程也能导入](pages/lessons/20261020-pytest-subprocess-source-path.md), [用保持打开的标准输入检查 CLI 是否提前阻塞](pages/lessons/20261020-cli-stdin-validation.md), [用完整单词参考算法检查截断边界](pages/lessons/20261020-truncate-independent-oracle.md).
4. Report approvals, implementation, test coverage, runtime observations, and packaging validation only within the scope directly established by accessible evidence — evidence: [输出契约冲突时先取得明确裁定](pages/lessons/20261020-conflicting-output-contracts.md), [pytest 能导入源码不代表 CLI 子进程也能导入](pages/lessons/20261020-pytest-subprocess-source-path.md), [字符计数先区分码点、可见字符和空白](pages/lessons/20261021-unicode-counting-contract.md), [用保持打开的标准输入检查 CLI 是否提前阻塞](pages/lessons/20261020-cli-stdin-validation.md).

title: Principles for software
description: Define precise behavior contracts, verify boundaries and real execution
  conditions independently, and limit claims to direct evidence.
kind: principles
---

# Principles for software

1. Define precise behavior contracts, including counting units and whitespace semantics, and obtain an explicit decision before implementing conflicting requirements — evidence: [字符计数先区分码点、可见字符和空白](pages/lessons/20261021-unicode-counting-contract.md), [输出契约冲突时先取得明确裁定](pages/lessons/20261020-conflicting-output-contracts.md)
2. Check boundary behavior with independently expressed reference algorithms and bounded exhaustive inputs, supplemented by empty and mixed inputs, rather than copying implementation logic or asserting only output length — evidence: [字符计数先区分码点、可见字符和空白](pages/lessons/20261021-unicode-counting-contract.md), [用完整单词参考算法检查截断边界](pages/lessons/20261020-truncate-independent-oracle.md)
3. Verify public CLI behavior in real subprocesses with deliberate import environments and both open and closed input pipes to expose failures hidden by library tests or immediate EOF — evidence: [pytest 能导入源码不代表 CLI 子进程也能导入](pages/lessons/20261020-pytest-subprocess-source-path.md), [用保持打开的标准输入检查 CLI 是否提前阻塞](pages/lessons/20261020-cli-stdin-validation.md), [用完整单词参考算法检查截断边界](pages/lessons/20261020-truncate-independent-oracle.md)
4. Limit claims about approval, implementation, test coverage, runtime behavior, and packaging validation to what accessible evidence directly establishes — evidence: [输出契约冲突时先取得明确裁定](pages/lessons/20261020-conflicting-output-contracts.md), [pytest 能导入源码不代表 CLI 子进程也能导入](pages/lessons/20261020-pytest-subprocess-source-path.md), [字符计数先区分码点、可见字符和空白](pages/lessons/20261021-unicode-counting-contract.md), [用保持打开的标准输入检查 CLI 是否提前阻塞](pages/lessons/20261020-cli-stdin-validation.md)
